title: Runner
description: A quick and easy plugin for speedrunners that lets you generate a random seed in 2 seconds using /run, with a built-in timer. You can also share lives between players with /share if you want.
body:
# RUNNER

### _PAPER ONLY_

Runner is a fast and lightweight plugin designed for speedrunners who want to start a run instantly with minimal setup.

With a single command, generate a brand-new random world and begin your run in seconds.

---

**⚡ Features**

Instant Run Setup
Use 
```
/run
```
 to generate a random seed (Overworld, Nether, End) and teleport all players in under 2 seconds.

Temporary Lobby System
Players are gathered in a temporary lobby before the run starts.

Life Sharing System
Use 
```
/share
```
 to enable shared health and hunger between all players.

Automatic Timer
A built-in timer is displayed in the scoreboard during the run.

Progress Notifications
Chat messages notify players of important milestones:
Nether entry time
End entry time

---

**🧩 Commands**


```
/run
```
 → Start a new run with a random seed

```
/share
```
 → Toggle shared health & hunger

---

**⚙️ Compatibility
**
Minecraft 
```
1.21.x
1.16.x
```

Works on Paper
